answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the fable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on commit-reveal schemes for front-running resistance.
